assertions: Independent Font handles with equal represented values satisfy native IsSameInstance.
Other runtime state and methods remain unchanged;existing value equality is reused.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task182 corrects the prior identity-only interpretation of Font IsSameInstance. Native Font stores cow_wrapper<ImplFont>;both Font operator== and IsSameInstance use its operator==,which returns shared-object identity OR ImplFont value equality. The existing represented Font Equals therefore supplies the correct observable value predicate for independent equal handles,without porting C++ ownership machinery. All stored state,copy/update guards and other Font methods retain emitted runtime tokens. Tests now require true for independent equal metadata/paint/alignment/geometry/transparency values and false for differences. Earlier task162/181 identity wording and the one equal-value identity expectation were incorrect;this correction supersedes that interpretation without rewriting historical source evidence. Physical COW/refcount/cache/weak/lifetime mechanisms remain erased under JS GC. Full unrepresented Font attributes/config/device/rendering and Calc/EditEngine pools/document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;no broad parity promotion.

gaps: Full unrepresented Font attributes,configuration/device/rendering and broad parity remain pending.
Physical COW identity/refcounts are not simulated.
